status: Locked snapshot of retained legacy records; no commit, push or deploy.
authority: Class data, talent-tree modules, resource contracts, resource guides and HUD components listed in sourceHashes.

resource.generationNote: Generated by parrying, cold-iron strikes, and confronting supernatural spells/entities. Spent on anathema seals and truth interrogations.
resource.mechanicsNote: Authority dictates the binding power of inquisitorial edicts and cold-iron nullifications.

spells.name: Cold-Iron Interrogation
spells.description: Touch a cold-iron brand to a heretic or captive. The cold metal burns when falsehoods are spoken, guaranteeing lie detection during interrogation. Out of combat.

spells.name: Iron Adjudication
spells.description: REACTION: When an enemy within 30ft begins casting a spell or activating a supernatural ability, immediately strike with cold-iron feedback, dealing storm damage and forcing a concentration check.

spells.name: Detect Corruption
spells.description: Strike cold iron against your cuirass to emit a chime that reveals invisible Wyrd horrors, hidden illusion doors, and tainted objects within 40 ft.

spells.name: Wyrd Banish
spells.description: Drag a targeted Wyrd-spawn or abomination into a void-cage for 1 minute on a failed save.

spells.name: Scent of Ash
spells.description: Mark a creature within 60 feet with a spectral brand of ash. Attacks against the marked target gain advantage and deal +1d4 ember damage for 10 minutes.

spells.name: Null-Salts Strike
spells.description: Imbue your weapon with flesh-burning null-salts. Your next melee attack deals +1d6 blight damage and generates 1 Authority on hit. Against supernatural targets, the damage increases to +1d8.

spells.name: Purge the Defiled
spells.description: Press rock salt into an ally to rip foreign magic from their nerves: removes curses, possessions, and mental crowd control; deals 1d8 smashing to the ally; gains 1 Authority if supernatural.

spells.name: Constricting Silver Binding
spells.description: Coat your blade in liquid silver for 1 minute. Each attack deals +1d4 ember damage. Against supernatural creatures, attacks also bypass magical resistance.

spells.name: Ash Step
spells.description: Dash 30 feet on a wave of living ash, ignoring difficult terrain and opportunity attacks. Gain advantage on your next melee attack.

spells.name: Sigil of Rotting Mana
spells.description: Afflict a target with a sigil unraveling their magic for 1 minute: spell attacks -2, spell save DC -1, and supernatural casters have disadvantage on concentration when damaged.

spells.name: Scourge of Submission
spells.description: Crack a null-salt lash (1d4 HP): 1d4 ember damage, and the target's next spell, summon, or ability is nullified (no save). Your bound horror instead regains 1 Dominance Die step.

spells.name: Curse Eater
spells.description: Tear a curse, hex, or magical affliction from a creature you touch, healing them for 2d8 and gaining 1 Authority if the affliction was supernatural magic.

spells.name: Shadow Ambush
spells.description: Dissolve into living shadow, becoming invisible for up to 1 minute. Your first melee attack from this state deals +2d6 blight damage with advantage and frightens supernatural targets.

spells.name: Anti-Magic Ward
spells.description: Project a 10-foot dome of anti-magic light for 3 rounds. Enemy spellcasters inside must Con save DC 14 or their spells fail. Allies inside gain +2 to saves against magic.

spells.name: Silver Hex
spells.description: Brand a creature with a silver sigil, making it vulnerable to ember damage: all ember damage against it is doubled, and supernatural targets also have disadvantage on concentration when damaged.

spells.name: Shackles of Searing Iron
spells.description: Tear searing shackles from your own veins (1d6 HP): a supernatural target takes 2d6 ember damage and is restrained for 2 rounds, taking 1d6 ember each turn. Spirit save DC 15 ends.

spells.name: Spirit Shackle
spells.description: Pin a shadow with anti-magic chains (3+ Authority): restrained 1 minute (Spirit DC 15 at turn end ends it); attacks on them have advantage; supernatural targets are silenced too.

spells.name: Inquisitor's Judgment
spells.description: Channel Authority into a melee strike for 6d10 ember. Against supernatural targets at 25 HP or lower, instantly kill them (Con DC 16 negates). On kill, gain 2 Authority.

spells.name: Anti-Magic Field
spells.description: Create a 15ft anti-magic sphere for 1 minute. No spells can be cast, summons vanish, magic items are suppressed, and concentration ends on entry.

spells.name: Inquisitor's Storm
spells.description: Unleash a 25ft shockwave of shadow and light: 8d6 blight (Con DC 17 halves), stun 1 round, and supernatural targets have all enchantments dispelled.

spells.name: Righteous Storm
spells.description: Summon a 30ft anti-magic storm for 1 minute: 3d8 ember per round, disadvantage on spellcasting, no mana recovery. Bound demons inside gain +1d6 ember on attacks.

spells.name: Judgment Day
spells.description: Call down pillars of sacred fire in a 40-foot radius. Deals 10d10 sacred damage (spirit save DC 19 halves) against supernatural creatures.

spells.name: Armageddon Edict
spells.description: Erase all magic in 100ft: 18d6 blight (Spirit DC 20 negates); spells and enchantments destroyed; failing supernatural casters lose spellcasting forever. Bound entities max Dominance 3 rounds.

spells.name: Witch-Sight
spells.description: Open your cold-iron eyes: perceive active magic, wards, glyphs, possession, corruption, and the Wyrd-touched as clearly as torchlight, including ash-trails from the last hour. Out of combat.

spells.name: Null-Salt Ward
spells.description: Lay null-salt across a threshold, camp, or circle: minor spirits, summoned creatures, and incorporeal undead cannot cross; spells crossing weaken; scrying fails. Lasts until broken. Out of combat.

spells.name: Bind and Interrogate
spells.description: Pin a spirit, ghost, demon, or summon in a cold-iron circle and compel it by the Barbed Vow: it cannot lie, though it may omit or riddle; strong wills resist. Lasts until released. Out of combat.

spells.name: Exorcise
spells.description: Drive the supernatural from a place or object: lift a haunting, break a curse, cleanse corruption. The thing is expelled, not destroyed. Heavier infestations need ritual time and Authority.

spells.name: Barbed Interdict
spells.description: Invoke the Barbed Vow's authority (1/long rest): demand entry, seizure, custody, or answers on supernatural matters. Advantage on Intimidation/Persuasion with authorities, 1 hour. Out of combat.

spells.name: Severing Cold-Iron Shackles
spells.description: Summon barbed cold-iron manacles on a spellcaster's wrists for 3 rounds. Attempting to cast causes severe mana burn and a DC 16 Spirit save or the spell fizzles and they are silenced 1 round.

spells.name: Cold-Iron Brand
spells.description: Sear a target with a white-hot cold-iron brand of the Barbed Vow, dealing 5d8 ember damage and burning away 1 active magical buff or enchantment.

spells.name: Ward of the Cold-Iron Aegis
spells.description: Project a 20ft perimeter of cold-iron filings and sacred salt for 3 rounds: allies inside gain +4 DR against supernatural and magical damage; hostile casters targeting them suffer disadvantage.

spells.name: Null-Zone Anchor
spells.description: Drive a cold-iron stake up to 45ft away, creating a 15ft dead-magic field for 3 rounds: teleportation and summons suppressed, spellcaster movement halved, mana regeneration disabled.

spells.name: Heretic's Scourge
spells.description: Pronounce ecclesiastical condemnation for 6d8 sacred (Spirit DC 16 half). If the target fails, their next offensive action must target the Inquisitor (compelled duel) or be forfeited entirely.

spells.name: Aura of the Iron Vow
spells.description: Emanate inquisitorial resolve across 30ft for 3 rounds: allies are immune to charm, fear, possession, and madness, and whenever an ally takes supernatural damage the attacker suffers 10 sacred recoil.

spells.name: Barbed Excommunication
spells.description: Pronounce excommunication on an extraplanar, undead, or possessed entity within 40ft: phased out 1 round (incapacitated, untargetable). On return, temporary buffs and minions are banished permanently.

spells.name: Soul-Scourge Purge
spells.description: Channel a searing ray of concentrated cold-iron embers through target's metaphysical core. Deals 8d8 ember damage (Spirit DC 17 for half) and reduces target's maximum mana by 20% for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Seal of Absolute Anathema
spells.description: Brand a target with the Anathema Seal for 3 rounds: cannot cast spells or activate supernatural traits, and all damage resistances are halved (Spirit DC 18 negates).

spells.name: Immutable Bastion of Truth
spells.description: Erect a 25ft sacred bastion of truth and null-salt for 3 rounds: allies within gain DR 8 against all damage, advantage on all saves, and immunity to forced movement and involuntary teleportation.

spells.name: Cold-Iron Crucible
spells.description: Rain cold-iron flechettes into a 20ft radius up to 50ft away: 8d10 smashing to hostiles (Agility DC 18 half). The area becomes a razor field dealing 2d8 per 5ft moved and grounding flyers.

spells.name: Absolute Supernatural Severance
spells.description: Sever every metaphysical lifeline, covenant, and conduit connecting an enemy to reality for 2 rounds: cannot cast, be magically healed, benefit from buffs, or act (Spirit DC 19 negates).

spells.name: Avatar of the Barbed Edict
spells.description: Channel the Barbed Vow's sovereign majesty for 5 rounds: 50 Temporary HP, DR 10, immunity to all status conditions, and melee attacks deal +3d8 sacred and dispel 1 buff on hit.

spells.name: The Final Confession
spells.description: Compel an enemy's soul to confess: for 3 rounds they have disadvantage on attacks and saves, and allies' critical threat range against them expands by 3 (Spirit DC 19 halves duration).

spells.name: Apocalypse of Salt
spells.description: Transmute a 30ft radius into a blinding salt-and-cold-iron vortex: 12d8 sacred to hostiles (Spirit DC 19 half), destroys magical hazards permanently, blinds supernatural creatures 2 rounds.

spells.name: The Grand Interdict
spells.description: Issue the supreme interdict across 50ft for 10 rounds: spellcasting prohibited, magic items inert, summons dissolve instantly; attempting to cast deals 4d10 backlash and stuns the caster 1 round.

spells.name: Eternity of Cold Iron
spells.description: Coat party members within 30ft in metaphysical cold-iron armor for 5 rounds: DR 15 against all damage, immunity to death effects, crits, and conditions, and no ability or stat can be drained.

spells.name: Wrath of the Seven Vows
spells.description: Ignite seven pillars of ancient cold iron across a 35ft radius: seven pillars erupt for 14d10 ember to hostiles (Spirit DC 20 half). Creatures reduced to 0 HP are obliterated into white salt.

nodes.name: Wyrd Pack
nodes.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. Bind up to 2 Wyrd-hounds simultaneously. While at 3 or more Authority and in stealth, your stealth attacks deal +1d6 additional damage.

nodes.name: Bind Wyrd-hound
nodes.description: Bind a Wyrd-spawn to your service: it fights at your side with a Dominance Die (d10) that degrades one step per action. The hound deals 1d8 wyrd damage per attack. Costs 2 Authority.

nodes.name: Shadow Mastery
nodes.description: You have advantage on attacks made from stealth, and at 3 or more Authority your stealth attacks also slow the target by 10 feet for 1 round.

nodes.name: Pack Mind
nodes.description: Your mind splits to track the whole pack: your Wyrd-hounds' DD degrades every 2 actions instead of every action.

nodes.name: Swarm Tactics
nodes.description: When 3 or more of your Wyrd-hounds attack the same target in a round, each of those attacks deals 1d6 additional sacred damage.

nodes.name: Steady Rein
nodes.description: Your grip holds under pressure: spend 1 Authority to restore one DD step on a bound hound.

nodes.name: Silent Execution
nodes.description: Stealth attacks against supernatural targets cannot be reduced; if the target is below half health, deal 2d6 additional blight damage.

nodes.name: Mass Restoration
nodes.description: One lash fortifies the whole pack: when you restore a hound's DD, all other bound hounds gain half the restoration.

nodes.name: Wyrd Cyclone
nodes.description: Once per combat: command all bound Wyrd-hounds to strike simultaneously. Each hound degrades its DD by 1 step but deals 2d6 additional sacred damage on the attack. Costs 2 Authority.

nodes.name: Pack Alpha
nodes.description: Your Wyrd-hounds no longer degrade DD on their first action each turn.

nodes.name: Hunter's Authority
nodes.description: The hunt legitimizes itself: each enemy damaged by a bound hound grants you 1 Authority (once per enemy per round).

nodes.name: Cold Iron Doctrine
nodes.description: Your weapons and your hounds' claws are anointed in remembering iron: all your and your pack's attacks ignore wyrd resistance, and supernatural enemies hit by them cannot heal for 1 round. Costs 3 Authority to anoint for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Undisputed
nodes.description: You are the sole commander of the Wyrd pack: your Authority maximum increases by 2, and hounds you command cannot be banished, dominated, or turned while you hold 3+ Authority.

nodes.name: Shared Stealth
nodes.description: When you enter stealth, your bound hounds vanish with you. The pack's stealth attacks from this shared stealth each gain +1d6 blight damage.

nodes.name: The Purging
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: For 1 minute, the full doctrine unrolls: bind up to 6 Wyrd-hounds regardless of slot limits, all DD degradation pauses, every attack — yours and the pack's — deals maximum damage to supernatural targets, and each enemy the pack kills restores 2 Authority and one DD step to every surviving hound. Costs all current Authority (minimum 4).

nodes.name: Writ of Binding
nodes.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 1.

nodes.name: Houndmaster General
nodes.description: Bound hounds inherit your doctrine: their attacks count as yours for Silent Execution and Cold Iron Doctrine effects.

nodes.name: First-Name Iron
nodes.description: Your cold iron has finished its recollection: all your damage against supernatural creatures is increased by +1d6 damage.

nodes.name: Quiet Writ
nodes.description: The purge leaves no paperwork: enemies killed by you or your pack from stealth die silently, without alerts, and their deaths cannot be scried.

nodes.name: Covenant of Iron
nodes.description: Your singular bond yields iron control: your Wyrd-hound's DD degrades every 2 actions instead of every action, and its attacks deal 1d6 additional sacred damage.

nodes.name: Spell Intercept
nodes.description: As a reaction when an enemy casts a spell within 60 feet, make a ranged attack with your cold iron: on a hit the spell is countered and you gain 2 Authority.

nodes.name: Iron Grip
nodes.description: Singular focus, stronger control: spend 2 Authority to restore your Wyrd-hound's DD to d10.

nodes.name: Mana Vortex
nodes.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. When you counter a spell, a vortex drains 2d6 mana from the caster; targets with no mana take the drain as wyrd damage instead.

nodes.name: Empowered Strikes
nodes.description: Your Wyrd-hound's attacks deal 1d8 additional sacred damage, and its critical hits restore 1 DD step and grant you 1 Authority.

nodes.name: Spell Nullification
nodes.description: Spells you counter are sealed: the caster cannot cast that spell again for 1 minute, and you may dispel one magical effect on yourself with each counter.

nodes.name: Dominant Wrath
nodes.description: Desperation sharpens the grip: when your Wyrd-hound's DD is at d8 or lower, its attacks deal 2d8 additional sacred damage.

nodes.name: Hound's Verdict
nodes.description: Command your hound to deliver the verdict: it pins a spellcaster within 30 feet for 1 round — the target is restrained, cannot cast, and takes 3d8 sacred damage. Costs 3 Authority.

nodes.name: Dispel Field
nodes.description: Create a 15-foot anti-magic field within 60 feet for 1 minute: spells cast into it automatically fail, magical effects inside are suppressed, and spellcasters inside take 3d6 arcane damage per round. Costs 4 Authority.

nodes.name: Arcane Dominator
nodes.description: You maintain two anti-magic effects simultaneously, and spells cast at you or allies within 30 feet are made with disadvantage.

nodes.name: Counter's Doctrine
nodes.description: Each successful Spell Intercept grants your hound +1d6 damage for 1 round (stacking up to 3 times).

nodes.name: The Bench
nodes.description: Erect the court itself: a 40-foot zone of judgment within 60 feet for 3 rounds. All enemy spells inside fail outright, all magical effects are suppressed, and each enemy caster inside takes 4d8 arcane damage at the start of their turns. Costs all current Authority (minimum 4).

nodes.name: Iron Ledger
nodes.description: The court keeps accounts: every spell countered, drained, or suppressed grants 1 Authority (once per enemy per round), and your Authority decays 50 points slower.

nodes.name: Verdant Null
nodes.description: Your anti-magic carries a blessing: allies inside your Dispel Fields are NOT suppressed and gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability instead.

nodes.name: Final Verdict
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: Read the sentence. A single target within 90 feet is stripped of ALL magic for 1 minute — spells fail, enchantments end, magic items go inert, and transformations revert. The condemned takes 8d10 sacred damage immediately and cannot benefit from any magical effect for the duration. Costs all current Authority (minimum 5).

nodes.name: Long Writ
nodes.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 1.

nodes.name: Contempt of Power
nodes.description: Spellcasters within 30 feet feel the court's disfavor: their spell costs increase by 2 mana.

nodes.name: Iron Sanction
nodes.description: Your hound is an officer of the court: it can now hold and deliver your Spell Intercept counterspell when you are unavailable.

nodes.name: The Stand
nodes.description: Witnesses do not test you twice: enemies who successfully cast a spell inside your anti-magic effects take 3d8 arcane backlash and are silenced for 1 round.

nodes.name: Hollow Pursuit
nodes.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. Gain +10 feet movement speed permanently, and track supernatural targets by scent within 60 feet.

nodes.name: Wyrd Embrace
nodes.description: Channel a Wyrd-hound within yourself: your Internal Dominance Die starts at d10, and your melee attacks deal 1d6 additional blight damage but degrade your Internal DD by 1 step.

nodes.name: Pursuit Mastery
nodes.description: Movement speed increases by 5 feet per Authority you hold, and when a supernatural target moves away from you, use your reaction to move up to your speed toward them.

nodes.name: Corruption Aura
nodes.description: The internal hound bleeds into the world: enemies within 10 feet take 1d6 blight damage at the start of their turns.

nodes.name: Condemn
nodes.description: Spend 3 Authority: knock a target within 30 feet back 20 feet and pin them to the ground — they take 3d8 sacred damage and are stunned for 1 round.

nodes.name: Inner Peace
nodes.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. When your Internal DD reaches 0 and the hound takes control, you regain command after 1 turn instead of 2.

nodes.name: Marked for Death
nodes.description: Mark a supernatural target for 10 minutes: you see them through walls, they cannot become invisible, and your attacks against them deal 2d6 additional sacred damage.

nodes.name: Rein In Fury
nodes.description: You have learned to milk the possession: spend 2 Authority to restore your Internal DD by one step.

nodes.name: Corruption Nova
nodes.description: Unleash the internal hound's fury in a 20-foot burst: 3d6 blight damage to all enemies. Resets your Internal DD to d6 regardless of its level.

nodes.name: Hound's Endurance
nodes.description: The hound inside keeps you standing: your maximum health increases by 10, and while your Internal DD is d8 or higher you regenerate 1d4 health per round.

nodes.name: No Escape
nodes.description: Marked targets cannot disengage, dash, or teleport away from you: if they try, your pursuit reaction triggers twice and pins them for 1 round on a hit.

nodes.name: Hollow Sovereign
nodes.description: You no longer lose control at Internal DD 0. Instead, enter Ascended Form for 3 rounds: +4 to Strength and Constitution checks, your melee attacks deal 4d10 blight damage, and Corruption Aura doubles. After it ends, take 4d10 wyrd damage and Internal DD resets to d6.

nodes.name: Confession
nodes.description: Pinned or marked enemies volunteer everything: enemies under your Condemn or Mark have their position broadcast to all allies and take 1d6 extra damage from everyone.

nodes.name: Hollow Bones
nodes.description: The hound has hollowed you into something tireless: you cannot be exhausted, and you do not need to sleep — trances of 2 hours restore you fully.

nodes.name: Saint and Hound
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: Saint and hound sign a joint writ. For 1 minute: Ascended Form persists without its ending backlash, your Internal DD cannot degrade below d8, all melee attacks deal maximum damage and apply your Corruption Aura's rot directly, and each supernatural enemy that dies within 60 feet restores 1 Authority and 2d6 health to you. Costs all current Authority (minimum 4).

nodes.name: Writ of Hunger
nodes.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 1.

nodes.name: Tireless Pursuer
nodes.description: The pursuit never rests: your movement speed increases by 10 feet, and your pursuit reactions no longer consume your reaction.

nodes.name: Rot Crown
nodes.description: Your Corruption Aura learns from the garden: enemies inside it have their healing reduced by 25 points.

nodes.name: Last Confession
nodes.description: Condemn's verdict sharpens: condemned targets below half health take 50% more damage from you.

resource.generationNote: Arcane Energy Points are captured magical energy in one 0–100 bank. Every valid interception method retains and accounts for finite residual; Silence Resonance describes saturation rather than a second implemented pool.
resource.mechanicsNote: At 100 AEP, a Meltdown triggers, violently venting raw arcane energy in a 30ft radius and damaging both allies and enemies.

spells.name: Kinetic Discharge
spells.description: Vent stored AEP into a 20ft frontal cone of compressed kinetic force, dealing storm damage and knocking enemies back 15ft.

spells.name: Null Field Bastion
spells.description: Create a 10ft anti-magic zone around yourself. Allies inside gain +4 to saves against spells and 50% spell damage reduction for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Radiation Quench
spells.description: Vent dangerous Silence Resonance from your plating, purging all debuffs from yourself and dealing heavy storm damage to all adjacent enemies.

spells.name: Prismatic Mirror Bastion
spells.description: Reflect a targeted hostile spell back at the caster, dealing full spell damage plus storm backlash to the attacking mage.

spells.name: Anti-Magic Shackle
spells.description: Clamp cold-iron leyline cuffs onto an enemy within 30ft. The target is Silenced and cannot cast spells or use magical abilities for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Overload Shockwave
spells.description: Detonate 50 stored AEP into a 30ft kinetic shockwave. Deals heavy storm damage and knocks all enemies prone.

spells.name: Fortress of Nullification
spells.description: Anchor into the earth. Become immune to all magical damage, forced movement, and crowd control for 2 rounds, absorbing all spells in 20ft.

spells.name: Leyline Devourer Nova
spells.description: Devour all magical energy in a 40ft radius. Strips all enemy buffs, drains enemy spellcasters of mana, and deals massive arcane damage.

spells.name: Singularity Aegis
spells.description: Form an anti-magic black hole in your fortress shield for 3 rounds. Swallows all hostile projectiles and reflects 100% of absorbed spell damage to enemies.

spells.name: Aegis Ward
spells.description: Instantly raise a prismatic barrier granting +3 Passive DR against an incoming strike.

spells.name: Spell Break
spells.description: Interrupt an enemy casting a spell within 30 ft by detonating a ward charge, forcing the spell to fail.

spells.name: Arcane Radiation
spells.description: Absorbed magic is radioactive poison: at your turn's end, unspent AEP deals blight equal to (AEP / 10, rounded down) and reduces max HP by the same until a long rest.

spells.name: Brittle Kinetic Shell
spells.description: Your silence-glass plating is hyper-specialized for absorbing energy, leaving you catastrophically vulnerable to martial trauma: permanent +50% vulnerability to all smashing and slicing damage.

spells.name: Silence Siphon
spells.description: A brutal melee strike that rips raw magic from the target: 1d8 physical and 1d8 storm. A spellcaster also loses 2d4 mana. Generates +15 AEP as the raw magic enters your blood.

spells.name: Entropic Aegis
spells.description: Volatile silence crystal absorbs 4d8 damage for 1 minute, generating 2 AEP per absorb. If shattered by a kinetic attack, it detonates inwardly for 2d6 smashing to you.

spells.name: Refract Kinetic
spells.description: A desperate survival technique: channel radiation into your bones for 1 round, suppressing your +50% smashing/slicing vulnerability and gaining +2 DR. Internal friction deals 1d4 blight instantly.

spells.name: Leyline Rift
spells.description: Tear the spatial leylines to instantly teleport up to 30ft to an enemy caster. The violent transition generates +10 AEP, but friction rips your flesh for 1d6 blight to yourself.

spells.name: Silence Intercept
spells.description: When an ally within 15ft is targeted by a spell, leap into its path as the new target: the impact is fully absorbed, generating AEP equal to its damage. Feedback blinds you until your next turn ends.

spells.name: Shattered Mirror Ward
spells.description: Raise an agonizing barrier of spatial refraction: when targeted by a spell, reflect it back at the caster for 100% damage. The refraction inflicts internal burns, dealing 1d8 blight to your organs.

spells.name: Warding Ribcage
spells.description: Spectral rib structures encase allies within 15ft, granting a shield absorbing 4d6 damage. Each time a shield absorbs, you take 2 blight from the feedback link but gain 2 AEP.

spells.name: Silence Suppression
spells.description: Choke a spell at its source, filling the target's lungs with silence ash. Force an Intelligence save; on a fail their spell is countered, and you absorb AEP equal to its level x 10.

spells.name: Entropic Supernova
spells.description: A devastating purge: unleash a blinding eruption of stored energy, dealing 6d8 storm to all enemies in 20ft (Agility half). Failing enemies are blinded by silence radiation 1 round.

spells.name: Tomb of the Aegis
spells.description: Encase yourself in silence crystal: complete immunity to all damage and effects for 1 round, but you cannot act. The shattering tomb deals 4d6 smashing to you and adjacent creatures.

spells.name: Violent Purge
spells.description: A cataclysmic blast to save your life from meltdown: expel ALL AEP (minimum 30), dealing storm damage equal to (AEP x 1.5) to all creatures within 20ft, including allies.

spells.name: Leyline Blackout
spells.description: Suppression of dimensional leylines: a 60ft zone of oppressive gravity suppresses all spells, magic items, and magical effects for 5 rounds. Casting strains your voice, silencing you 1 minute.

spells.name: Cosmic Unraveling
spells.description: Instantly end all magical phenomena on the battlefield, regardless of power or origin. The sheer volume consumed puts you into Critical Meltdown: reduced to 1 HP with defensive plating shattered.

spells.name: Aegis Beacon
spells.description: Tap your steel chest plate so it gleams with silver light, projecting a narrow beam that serves as a distress beacon or illuminates a dark cavern.

spells.name: Ley-Reading
spells.description: Open your scarred senses to magic in a place or object: perceive active spells, enchantments, residue, magical traps, and leylines, glowing like heat-shimmer only you can see. Out of combat.

spells.name: Aegis-Ward
spells.description: Raise a tuned prismatic barrier over a doorway, object, or small area that drinks incoming spells and weak traps; it stops spells, not steel, and cracks once full. Out of combat.

spells.name: Resonance Discharge
spells.description: Dump stored AEP into a mechanism, lock, construct, or device: power or overload it, force a jammed mechanism, or blast an arcane seal. Out of combat.

spells.name: Disenchant
spells.description: Drain an enchanted object's magic into your flesh, suppressing the enchantment (trap inert, ward down, cursed item asleep) and gaining AEP. It returns when you stop feeding. Out of combat.

spells.name: Glow-Lantern
spells.description: Let the magic in your veins surface as pale-blue light: brighten to a 30ft radius or dampen to a pulse (you can never go fully dark). The glow soothes magically-induced dread. Out of combat.

spells.name: Containment Cycle
spells.description: Spend 15 AEP to run a controlled bleed-off. For 3 rounds, Arcane Radiation deals no damage and you vent 10 AEP at the start of each of your turns. Meltdown cannot trigger while active.

spells.name: Spell Riposte
spells.description: Hurl a spent spell's afterimage back at its caster for 3d8 storm + arcane damage. Spirit save DC 15 or silenced for 1 round. Trigger: a spell hits you or an ally within 15 ft. Gain 10 AEP.

spells.name: Spellward Bond
spells.description: Bond an ally for 3 rounds. The first hostile spell each round that targets them redirects to you, deals half damage, and grants AEP equal to the damage prevented. Costs 10 AEP.

spells.name: Prism Cocoon
spells.description: Instantly encase an ally in silence-glass. Until the start of their next turn they are immune to spell damage and hostile spell effects but restrained. You take 1d8 blight and gain 15 AEP.

spells.name: Kinetic Reversal
spells.description: Drive a kinetic counter through a caster's stance for 4d10 smashing + storm damage. If they have cast a spell since your last turn, add 3d8 storm and knock them back 10 ft. Gain 10 AEP.

spells.name: Scrying Blackout
spells.description: Flood a 30 ft area with leyline static for 1 minute: divination cannot see in or out, enemies inside cannot teleport, and allies gain +4 to saves against scrying and divination.

spells.name: Saturation Flush
spells.description: Vent 40 AEP in one controlled purge. Heal 3d8 + spirit HP and erase all maximum-HP loss suffered from Arcane Radiation. Purely restorative; deals no damage.

spells.name: Entropy Lance
spells.description: Fire a 60 ft lance of unravelling energy for 5d10 + intelligence arcane damage to all in line. Each target loses one spell buff, and you gain 5 AEP per buff stripped.

spells.name: Warding Verge
spells.description: Plant a 15 ft spell-devouring threshold for 1 minute. The first hostile spell crossing it is absorbed entirely, granting you AEP equal to its damage. Allies inside gain +3 DR against spells.

spells.name: Mirror Phalanx
spells.description: Raise a mirror phalanx for 2 rounds: allies within 15 ft reflect 50% of spell damage taken back at the caster as arcane. You gain 5 AEP each time this reflects.

spells.name: Ley-Fracture Hammer
spells.description: Slam a hammer wreathed in fractured leyline force for 6d8 smashing + 2d8 storm damage. Destroy all magical barriers on the target; Spirit save DC 16 or dazed for 1 round. Gain 10 AEP.

spells.name: Void Anchor
spells.description: Anchor a caster to the leylines for 3 rounds. Spirit save DC 17 or they are silenced and pinned in place; each teleport attempt deals 2d10 arcane feedback damage to them.

spells.name: Resonance Bastion
spells.description: Overload your aegis into a 20 ft bastion for 1 round: allies inside are immune to spell damage and hostile spell effects. You immediately gain 30 AEP and take 3d8 blight.

spells.name: Devouring Grasp
spells.description: Seize a caster for 6d10 + strength storm damage and drain all their remaining mana, adding +1 damage per mana drained. Gain AEP equal to half the mana drained (max 25).

spells.name: Criticality Halo
spells.description: Hold your core at criticality for 3 rounds: Meltdown cannot trigger and enemies within 15 ft take 4d8 storm at the start of each of your turns. When it ends, vent 50 AEP.

spells.name: Echo Exodus
spells.description: Teleport yourself and allies within 20 ft up to 60 ft away, leaving a silence-echo duplicate behind. The next 2 spells targeting the echo are absorbed, granting you 15 AEP each.

nodes.name: Oath-Steel Bond
nodes.description: Tallyn oath-steel fused to your body hardens with every vow witnessed. You gain +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability and +3 maximum health.

nodes.name: Arcane Absorption
nodes.description: Your warding soul drinks hostile magic. When you take magical damage (ember, rime, storm, arcane, blight, wyrd, or sacred), you gain 1 AEP for every 2 damage taken.

nodes.name: Arcane Shield
nodes.description: Instantly wrap yourself in a shearing arcane barrier that absorbs 15 damage for 3 rounds.

nodes.name: Reinforced Wards
nodes.description: Your warding lattice is strung tighter. All shield spells you cast absorb an additional 5 damage.

nodes.name: Warden's Fortitude
nodes.description: While any shield is active on you, you gain +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability.

nodes.name: Barrier of Protection
nodes.description: Project a ward onto an ally within 30 feet, absorbing 20 damage for 3 rounds.

nodes.name: Absorption Mastery
nodes.description: You squeeze every drop from captured magic. Whenever one of your shields absorbs spell damage, you gain 1 additional AEP.

nodes.name: Elemental Ward
nodes.description: Etch a resistance rune on an ally within 30 feet: they gain +4 Damage Reduction to one chosen damage type for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Mass Shielding
nodes.description: Unfold a lattice of wards over all allies within 15 feet, absorbing 10 damage each for 3 rounds.

nodes.name: Anti-Magic Zone
nodes.description: Anchor a null-contract over a 15-foot zone for 1 minute: enemy spells cast inside cost 3 additional mana, and allies inside gain +2 Damage Reduction to magical damage.

nodes.name: Overflowing Reservoir
nodes.description: When one of your shields is fully consumed, you retain the surplus: gain AEP equal to half the damage that shield absorbed, up to 10 AEP.

nodes.name: Warden's Sacrifice
nodes.description: For 1 round, all damage that a chosen ally within 30 feet would take is redirected to you instead.

nodes.name: Fortress Mode
nodes.description: Seal every ward at once: until your next turn, all active shields you maintain absorb double damage and you are immune to magical damage.

nodes.name: Bulwark Doctrine
nodes.description: Allies you shield with Barrier of Protection or Mass Shielding gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability for the shield's duration.

nodes.name: Reflective Ward
nodes.description: Wreathe your shields in mirror-force for 3 rounds: 10 points of all damage absorbed by your shields is reflected at the attacker as arcane damage.

nodes.name: Ultimate Ward
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: Weave an absolute ward over yourself and all allies within 30 feet, absorbing 60 damage each and granting immunity to all magical effects for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Aegis Eternal
nodes.description: Your wards approach permanence. All shield spells you cast absorb an additional 5 damage.

nodes.name: Prismatic Bulwark
nodes.description: Raise a refracting wall over all allies within 20 feet, absorbing 25 damage each for 3 rounds.

nodes.name: Oathbound
nodes.description: Your reservoir deepens beyond the standard issue: your maximum AEP increases by 5.

nodes.name: Unchanging Vow
nodes.description: Your ward-work flows without pause: the cooldowns of your shield spells are reduced by 20 points.

nodes.name: Reflective Barrier
nodes.description: For 3 rounds, 25 points of the magical damage you take is reflected back at the attacker as arcane damage.

nodes.name: Spell Disruption
nodes.description: Counter a spell being cast within 30 feet: the caster must succeed a saving throw or their spell fails.

nodes.name: Counter Magic
nodes.description: Every successful counter or reflection feeds you: gain 2 additional AEP whenever you counter or reflect a spell.

nodes.name: Mirror Shield
nodes.description: Raise a perfect mirror: the next 1 spell cast at you is reflected in full — damage and effects — back at its caster. Lasts 3 rounds.

nodes.name: Echo Damage
nodes.description: Reflected magic returns with interest: spells you reflect deal an additional 1d4 arcane damage to the caster.

nodes.name: Perfect Reflection
nodes.description: Your mirrors admit no negotiation: reflected spells ignore the caster's resistances.

nodes.name: Mana Burn
nodes.description: Reflection scorches the source: when you reflect a spell, its caster loses 1d4 mana.

nodes.name: Mirror Field
nodes.description: Flood a 20-foot zone with hanging mirrors for 1 minute: allies inside reflect 25 points of magical damage they take back at attackers.

nodes.name: Spell Nullification
nodes.description: Refuse the spell entirely: counter a spell within 30 feet so completely that it is nullified, and you gain 5 AEP from its collapse.

nodes.name: Unbreakable Mirror
nodes.description: Your reflective works are tempered beyond glass: you gain +2 Damage Reduction to magical damage.

nodes.name: Reciprocal Ward
nodes.description: For 3 rounds, melee attackers who strike you take 1d6 arcane damage in return.

nodes.name: Reflection Nova
nodes.description: Overload every mirror at once: until your next turn, all spells cast at you are automatically reflected, and at turn's end you release the stored energy as a nova dealing 4d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 30 feet.

nodes.name: Mirror Soul
nodes.description: You have become the surface itself: Reflective Barrier and Mirror Shield cost 5 fewer AEP to cast.

nodes.name: Prismatic Shear
nodes.description: Counter a spell being cast within 30 feet; when the caster fails their save, the shear lashes them for 2d8 arcane damage in addition to disrupting the spell.

nodes.name: Perfect Mirror
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: For 1 round, every spell targeting you or allies within 30 feet is reflected at its caster with double damage and full effects.

nodes.name: Mirror Mastery
nodes.description: Every surface serves the doctrine: all reflected damage you deal is increased by +1d6 damage.

nodes.name: Arcane Retribution
nodes.description: Your wards die loudly: when one of your shields is destroyed, it detonates for 2d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 15 feet.

nodes.name: Thousand Faces
nodes.description: Split into 2 mirror images for 1 minute. Each image automatically dodges one spell targeted at you, then shatters, dealing 1d8 arcane damage to the caster.

nodes.name: Eternal Vigil
nodes.description: You stand watch beyond exhaustion: your maximum AEP increases by 5.

nodes.name: Arcane Strike
nodes.description: Channel stored AEP into your weapon: your next melee strike this turn deals an additional 1d6 arcane damage.

nodes.name: Mana Vampirism
nodes.description: Your weapon drinks as it cuts: each melee hit drains 1 mana from the target and heals you for 1 health.

nodes.name: Reaver's Edge
nodes.description: You know exactly where the magic keeps its purse: you gain +1 to hit on attacks against enemies with a mana pool.

nodes.name: Empowered Strike
nodes.description: Dump the reservoir through the blade: spend 10 AEP to empower your next melee strike with an additional 3d6 arcane damage.

nodes.name: Siphoned Fury
nodes.description: Stolen mana makes the blade eager: after you drain 5 or more mana in a turn, your next attack deals an additional 1d4 arcane damage.

nodes.name: Overcharge
nodes.description: Tear the siphon open: your mana drains pull 1 additional mana, but you take 1 arcane damage each time you drain.

nodes.name: Wicked Draft
nodes.description: What you take, you spoil: enemies you drain mana from take 1 arcane damage for every 2 mana drained.

nodes.name: Energy Surge
nodes.description: Crack the reservoir open in reverse: spend 15 AEP to instantly restore 20 mana.

nodes.name: Arcane Combustion
nodes.description: Overloaded targets detonate: when you kill an enemy with a melee attack, it erupts for 2d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 10 feet.

nodes.name: Spell Theft
nodes.description: Why learn when you can take: steal 1 prepared spell from a target you have drained this combat. You may cast it once within 1 minute before it dissolves.

nodes.name: Vampiric Empowerment
nodes.description: The drinking sharpens you: after you have drained 10 or more mana this combat, you gain +1 to hit on melee attacks.

nodes.name: Mana Rend
nodes.description: Tear the well out entirely: drain all mana from a target within 30 feet (up to 30), gain 5 AEP for every 10 mana drained, and leave the target unable to cast for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Leech Ward
nodes.description: Sheathe yourself in stolen current for 3 rounds: 25 points of the mana you drain is also converted into an arcane shield absorbing up to 10 damage.

nodes.name: Hungering Blade
nodes.description: The steel has learned to sip on its own: Arcane Strike and Empowered Strike also drain 2 mana from the target on hit.

nodes.name: Aether Reaper
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: Harvest the field entire: drain 20 mana from every enemy within 30 feet, deal 3d6 arcane damage to each, gain 2 AEP for every 10 mana drained, and gain +2 to hit for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Deep Siphon
nodes.description: The siphon finds deeper veins: all mana you drain is increased by 1.

nodes.name: Arcane Hunger
nodes.description: What flows in does not leave: each time you drain mana, you gain 1 AEP.

nodes.name: Reaver's Momentum
nodes.description: Drinking puts speed in the blood: after you drain mana, you gain +15 points movement speed for 1 round.

nodes.name: Reservoir Bloom
nodes.description: The well widens to match the thirst: your maximum AEP increases by 5.

resource.generationNote: Vials distilled during rests or synthesized from organic reagents. Contraptions deployed and reclaimed.
resource.mechanicsNote: Toxin vials coat weapons or fill aerosol flasks. Contraption parts are spent on deployable turrets and needle traps.

spells.name: Acid Unlocking
spells.description: Apply a drop of corrosive Florae acid to quietly dissolve metal lock tumblers or mechanical trap gears over 10 seconds without making sound.

spells.name: False Death
spells.description: Ingest a micro-vial of numbing peat-extract, dropping pulse and body temperature to zero. Enemies believe you are dead and ignore you for up to 10 minutes.

spells.name: Venom Strike
spells.description: Drive a poisoned blade into the target, injecting a toxin that deals 2d6 blight damage and leaves 1d6 blight seeping through their veins each round for 4 rounds.

spells.name: Toxic Cloud
spells.description: Hurl a vial that bursts into a 20-foot cloud of choking blight, dealing 5d6 blight damage and leaving 2d6 blight searing their lungs each round for 4 rounds (Constitution DC 16 for half).

spells.name: Poison Gas Trap
spells.description: Rig a contraption of salvaged glass and blight that bursts when a foe steps within 5 feet, dealing 2d6 blight damage and slowing them by 10 feet for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Contraption Network
spells.description: Link all your active contraptions. When one triggers, all activate simultaneously for devastating combos.

spells.name: Overcharged Trap
spells.description: Deploy a supercharged contraption erupting in a 15ft blast: 8d6 ember, 3 Durability corroded, and 1d6 ember burning per round for 3 rounds (Agility DC 17 half).

spells.name: Crippling Toxin
spells.description: A debilitating poison: 3d6 blight and withers for 5 rounds; -4 attack, -2 Durability, -10ft movement, disadvantage on saves (Con DC 16 for reduced penalties).

spells.name: Chaos Grenade
spells.description: Throw a grenade of blight and ember: 5d6 blight + 3d8 ember in a 20ft burst; survivors are confused and attack at random for 2 rounds (Int DC 17 negates confusion).

spells.name: Total Shutdown
spells.description: Flood the target with a rare neurotoxin that shuts down their body for 1 round - they can only react, lose 3 Durability, and suffer disadvantage on all saves (Constitution DC 19 for a reduced effect).

spells.name: Apply Weapon Poison
spells.description: Apply a poison to your weapon for 1 AP. The poison lasts for 3 attacks or until end of combat.

spells.name: Antidote
spells.description: Quickly craft and administer an antidote to cure poison or disease.

spells.name: Explosive Concoction
spells.description: Mix and hurl a volatile concoction that detonates in a 10-foot blast for 3d6 ember damage (Agility DC 15 for half).

spells.name: Smoke Bomb
spells.description: Deploy a smoke bomb that obscures vision and provides cover.

spells.name: Alchemical Outbreak
spells.description: Uncork a plague: 12d6 blight, spreading to enemies within 10ft at their turn start for 3d6 blight per round and 4 Con drain for 5 rounds (Con DC 18 half).

spells.name: Mechanical Monstrosity
spells.description: Salvage and animate a Large mechanical monstrosity (80 HP, 4 Durability, 6 DR) that fights at your command for 5 rounds, smashing foes for 4d10 or loosing missiles for 3d8 in a 15-foot spread.

spells.name: Sabotage Supreme
spells.description: Trigger synchronized sabotage across a 25-foot radius: every enemy deals half damage, suffers -5 to hit, and feels their own gear turn against them for 3 rounds (Agility DC 18 halves the duration).

spells.name: Extinction Toxin
spells.description: Inject the ultimate blight - a toxin so concentrated it ignores poison immunity entirely, dealing 18d6 blight damage (Constitution DC 20 for half).

spells.name: War Machine
spells.description: Deploy a Huge war machine (150 HP, 6 Durability, 8 DR) bristling with weapons for 5 rounds - it crushes for 6d10, lobs artillery for 8d8 in a 30-foot radius, or projects shields granting allies +5 DR.

spells.name: Total System Failure
spells.description: Trigger total system failure across a 40-foot radius - magic items fall inert, buffs unravel, foes cannot cast for 1 round, and all suffer -10 DR for 3 rounds (Spirit DC 19 halves the duration).

spells.name: Apocalypse Plague
spells.description: Unleash apocalyptic virulence across 100ft: 22d6 blight and 4d10 blight seeping from every vein each round as it spreads without end (Con DC 22 half).

spells.name: Mechanical Army
spells.description: Raise an army of eight mechanical soldiers (40 HP, 3 Durability, 4 DR each) across a 30-foot radius, each striking for 2d10 damage over 5 rounds of relentless advance.

spells.name: Reality Bomb
spells.description: Detonate the ultimate sabotage device: a 50ft blast for 22d6 storm that tears reality, disorienting survivors 1 round and suppressing all magic for 1 minute (Con DC 22 half).

spells.name: Poison Dart
spells.description: Fire a poison dart that deals 1d6 blight damage plus your Intelligence modifier and weakens the target (-1 to attack for 1 round).

spells.name: Noxious Fumes
spells.description: Create a small toxic cloud that deals 1d6 blight damage to enemies in a 10-foot radius, then lingers for 2 rounds dealing 1d4 blight each round.

spells.name: Purifying Antidote
spells.description: Create an antidote that removes all poison effects from an ally.

spells.name: Venom Blast
spells.description: Strike with concentrated venom for 4d6 blight damage that eats through the target's Durability and DR, corroding Durability by 2 for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Toxic Shock
spells.description: Shock an enemy with concentrated toxins for 3d6 blight damage, leaving them nauseated - disadvantage on attacks and checks, halved movement - for 1 round (Constitution DC 16 to resist).

spells.name: Poison Bomb
spells.description: Throw a poison bomb that bursts in a 20-foot radius for 5d6 blight damage and corrodes 1 Durability from every enemy caught in the cloud for 2 rounds (Constitution DC 16 for half).

spells.name: Deadly Toxin
spells.description: Apply a deadly toxin that deals 6d8 blight damage, then 1d8 blight each round for 5 rounds as the victim's blood thins to water.

spells.name: Toxic Wave
spells.description: Send a 60-foot wave of toxic blight dealing 7d6 damage and slowing every enemy caught in its path by 10 feet for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Virulent Plague
spells.description: Release a virulent plague that leaps between up to six enemies within 20 feet of each other, dealing 10d6 blight damage as it jumps.

spells.name: Vial Dependency
spells.description: Your poisons need reagents. Begin each encounter with 5 Vials; each poison spell costs 1. At 0 Vials, poison spells have a 50% chance to fail. Regain 1 Vial per enemy killed within 30ft.

spells.name: Concoction Instability
spells.description: When you take fire or ember damage, one random poison active on an enemy prematurely detonates, dealing its remaining damage to YOU instead of the target. Your concoctions react poorly to heat.

spells.name: Poison, Not Paralysis
spells.description: No Stun, Paralyze, or Freeze. Your poisons NAUSEATE: disadvantage on attacks and checks, halved movement. Targets can still move and act; they just do it badly. You weaken, never lock down.

spells.name: Chemical Analysis
spells.description: Taste, smell, or test a substance and read its chemistry: what it is, its components, toxins, and what it does (plus the antidote if known). Your dead tastebuds are the instrument. Out of combat.

spells.name: Caustic Flask
spells.description: Brew a precise corrosive: dissolve a lock's pins, eat a hinge, etch thin metal, scissor rope, or destroy a document. Quiet fuming acid, not an explosion; take 1 blight back-splash. Out of combat.

spells.name: Smoke Screen
spells.description: A billowing chemical smoke blocks vision, defeats scent tracking, and irritates pursuers' lungs (they cough and slow). Ideal for retreats, break-ins, or masking your party's count. Out of combat.

spells.name: Brew Antidote
spells.description: From your saturated blood, quickly culture an antidote to any poison, venom, or disease you have diagnosed in an ally; you take a brief toxic flush (1 blight) to brew it. Out of combat.

spells.name: Slow Taint
spells.description: Slip a slow, untraceable reagent into food or drink: hours later the victim suffers cramping, weakness, or deep sleep with no obvious cause. A wary target may taste it. Out of combat.

spells.name: Alchemical Adhesive
spells.description: Lob quick-curing resin across 35ft to coat a 15ft radius: hostiles caught are rooted for 1 round (speed 0) and move at half speed for 2 more rounds.

spells.name: Vapor Veil
spells.description: Release a neutralizing aerosol in a 15ft radius for 3 rounds: allies inside gain +4 to saves against blight, poison, and airborne afflictions, plus light concealment against ranged attacks.

spells.name: Narcotic Vapor
spells.description: Discharge a soporific in a 20ft radius up to 40ft away: enemies inhaling it make a Spirit save or become dazed, unable to take reactions, disadvantage on mental checks, and lose 1 AP next turn.

spells.name: Calcified Antidote
spells.description: Inject a metallic curdling serum: purge all poison, blight, and bleed, then calcify the dermal layer for 20 Temporary HP and DR 4 against physical damage for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Pneumatic Stasis Piston
spells.description: Launch a magnetic vice-mine at an enemy up to 40ft away: hydraulic jaws clamp their limbs or weapon, disarming them and preventing physical attacks for 2 rounds (Agility DC 16 negates).

spells.name: Cryogenic Distillate
spells.description: Shatter an endothermic flask across 30ft: the air flash-freezes; ground becomes difficult terrain, and moving or casting requires an Agility save or fall prone and lose 1 AP.

spells.name: Caustic Deluge
spells.description: Launch a pressurized battery of volatile acid canisters across a 25ft radius, dealing 8d6 blight damage and melting enemy defenses, reducing their DR by 4 and Durability by 1 for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Biochemical Siphon
spells.description: Attach a pneumatic tether needle to an enemy within 40ft. For 3 rounds, drain 15 HP from the victim at the start of each turn to heal yourself, and reduce their physical damage dealt by 50%.

spells.name: Stasis Gas Dispersal
spells.description: Flood 30ft with catalytic neurotoxin: hostiles make a DC 19 Spirit save or enter biochemical stasis 2 rounds, and all damage dealt to them in stasis is stored and delivered when the gas clears.

spells.name: Panacea Concoction
spells.description: Shatter a universal panacea across 30ft: allies are cleansed of all negative conditions, heal 40 HP, gain immunity to poison, blight, and mind-affecting effects, and DR 8 for 3 rounds.

nodes.name: Envenomed Edge
nodes.description: Passive: Your weapon attacks deal +1d4 additional blight damage and apply a mild toxin for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Venom Channels
nodes.description: Passive: Blight and poison damage-over-time effects you apply deal +1 additional blight damage per tick.

nodes.name: Paralytic Tincture
nodes.description: Passive: Enemies affected by your toxins suffer -1 to their attack rolls and dexterity saving throws.

nodes.name: Hemotoxin Needle
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a venom-coated needle at a target within 40 feet dealing 1d8 blight damage and inflicting Poisoned (1d4 blight/rd for 2 rounds).

nodes.name: Metabolic Drain
nodes.description: Passive: When you hit a poisoned enemy, restore 2 Hit Points and reduce the target's movement speed by 5 feet.

nodes.name: Noxious Cloud
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Shatter a vial creating a 15-foot cloud of toxic vapor within 45 feet for 2 rounds. Enemies inside take 2d6 blight damage upon entering or ending their turn inside.

nodes.name: Virulent Spores
nodes.description: Passive: When an enemy dies while affected by your toxins, they release a spore cloud dealing 1d6 blight damage to all enemies within 10 feet.

nodes.name: Terminal Dosage
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Strike a poisoned enemy in melee, detonating all toxin stacks within their body for 2d10 blight damage and Staggering them for 1 round.

nodes.name: Viper Reflexes
nodes.description: Passive: Your weapon attacks gain +1 to hit against poisoned enemies, and your Opportunity Attacks inflict Poisoned.

nodes.name: Immunological Ruin
nodes.description: Passive: Enemies affected by your toxins have their Damage Reduction reduced by 2 and cannot benefit from regeneration.

nodes.name: Plague Mist Eruption
nodes.description: Spend 2 AP: Release a 25-foot cone of virulent neurotoxin dealing 3d8 blight damage and forcing all enemies hit to roll a Fortitude save or be Blinded for 1 round.

nodes.name: Terminal Dosage Resonance
nodes.description: Passive: Your class abilities deal +1d4 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource when below half health.

nodes.name: Unyielding Resolve
nodes.description: Passive: You gain +1 Damage Reduction against all attacks and advantage on saving throws against stun and fear.

nodes.name: Avatar of the Viper
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 2 AP: For 2 rounds, all your attacks apply maximum toxin stacks, your blight damage ignores all enemy Poison/Blight resistance, and whenever an enemy takes poison damage, you heal for 3 Hit Points.

nodes.name: Toxicologist Doctrine
nodes.description: Passive: All damage and healing dealt by your Toxicologist abilities is increased by +1 flat magnitude.

nodes.name: Miasma Heart
nodes.description: Passive: You are completely immune to Poison, Blight, and Disease, and whenever you are targeted by a healing spell, you gain +3 bonus Hit Points.

nodes.name: Catalytic Shock
nodes.description: Passive: When you score a critical hit on a poisoned target, shockwaves of toxin deal 2d8 blight damage to all other enemies within 15 feet.

nodes.name: Transcendent Precision
nodes.description: Passive: All critical strikes deal +1d6 bonus damage and restore 1d4 Hit Points.

nodes.name: Spring Snare
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Deploy a concealed spring snare on a space within 30 feet. When an enemy steps on it, deals 1d6 piercing damage and Immobilizes them for 1 round.

nodes.name: Spring Armature
nodes.description: Passive: Your throw range for all grenades, vials, and deployables increases by 10 feet.

nodes.name: Reinforced Bracing
nodes.description: Passive: You gain +1 Armor and 2 Damage Reduction against area hazards and environmental damage.

nodes.name: Alchemical Smoke
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a smoke canister up to 35 feet creating a 15-foot obscured zone for 2 rounds. Creatures inside have +2 Defense against ranged attacks.

nodes.name: Miniature Turret
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Deploy a miniature tripod turret within 25 feet for 2 rounds. At the end of each turn, it fires a needle at the nearest enemy for 1d6 piercing damage.

nodes.name: Flashbang Grenade
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a magnesium concussion bomb up to 35 feet. Deals 2d6 sonic damage in a 15-foot radius and Dazes targets for 1 round on a failed Reflex save.

nodes.name: Pneumatic Thrusters
nodes.description: Passive: Your movement speed increases by 10 feet, and you can Disengage as a free reaction once per combat encounter.

nodes.name: Grapnel Winch
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Fire a high-tension steel cable up to 40 feet. Pull yourself immediately to an unoccupied location or pull an ally out of danger to your side.

nodes.name: Claymore Mine
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Plant a directional claymore trap. When an enemy approaches within 10 feet, it discharges a 15-foot cone dealing 2d8 piercing damage and knocking targets Prone.

nodes.name: Clockwork Exoskeleton
nodes.description: Passive: You gain +2 to Strength checks and saving throws, and your carrying capacity and weapon strike damage increase by +1d4 bludgeoning.

nodes.name: Deployable Automaton
nodes.description: Spend 2 AP: Deploy a brass automaton within 15 feet for 3 rounds (25 HP, +2 Armor). It intercepts attacks meant for nearby allies and attacks adjacent foes for 2d6 bludgeoning damage each round.

nodes.name: Grapnel Winch Resonance
nodes.description: Passive: Your class abilities deal +1d4 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource when below half health.

nodes.name: Unyielding Resolve
nodes.description: Passive: You gain +1 Damage Reduction against all attacks and advantage on saving throws against stun and fear.

nodes.name: Grand Mechanist Overdrive
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 2 AP: For 2 rounds, all your traps, turrets, and gadgets cost 0 AP to deploy, trigger immediately upon deployment, and your turrets fire twice per round.

nodes.name: Toxicologist Doctrine
nodes.description: Passive: All damage and healing dealt by your Toxicologist abilities is increased by +1 flat magnitude.

nodes.name: Salvage Protocol
nodes.description: Passive: When any trap, turret, or automaton expires or is destroyed, restore 6 Hit Points and gain 1 Action Point on your next turn.

nodes.name: Tungsten Munitions
nodes.description: Passive: All your gadget, turret, and weapon physical damage bypasses up to 4 points of Armor and ignores physical damage reduction.

nodes.name: Transcendent Precision
nodes.description: Passive: All critical strikes deal +1d6 bonus damage and restore 1d4 Hit Points.

nodes.name: Vitriol Flask
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a flask of concentrated vitriol up to 40 feet dealing 1d8 acid damage and melting 1 point of enemy Armor for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Caustic Coating
nodes.description: Passive: Your weapon attacks deal +1d4 acid damage and degrade enemy Armor by 1 for 1 round.

nodes.name: Demolition Insight
nodes.description: Passive: You gain +1 to hit against armored enemies and constructs, and your attacks deal +2 flat damage to objects and barriers.

nodes.name: Breaching Charge
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Plant an explosive charge on a foe or structure within 30 feet. Detonates for 2d6 bludgeoning + 1d4 fire damage and knocks targets Prone on a failed Fortitude save.

nodes.name: Acid Trap
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Lay a pressurized acid canister up to 30 feet away. When triggered, sprays a 10-foot radius dealing 1d8 acid damage and reducing enemy movement speed by 10 feet for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Vitriol Torrent
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Spray a 20-foot cone of boiling acid dealing 2d6 acid damage to all enemies and reducing their Armor by 2 for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Ablative Slag Plating
nodes.description: Passive: When an enemy strikes you with a melee weapon, their weapon is corroded, suffering -1 to hit and -1 damage for 2 rounds (stacks up to 3 times).

nodes.name: Thermite Core Bomb
nodes.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a white-hot thermite incendiary within 40 feet. Detonates in a 15-foot radius dealing 2d10 ember + acid damage, completely melting all enemy temporary hit point shields and shredding 3 Armor.

nodes.name: Caustic Fumes
nodes.description: Passive: All your acid attacks leave lingering toxic fumes. Enemies that take acid damage suffer +1d4 bonus acid damage on the next attack that hits them.

nodes.name: Structural Shatter
nodes.description: Passive: Critical hits with your weapons or explosives reduce target Armor to 0 for 1 round and inflict Stagger.

nodes.name: Obliteration Payload
nodes.description: Spend 2 AP: Launch a massive canister containing dual chambers of acid and explosive nitro up to 45 feet. Deals 3d8 acid + 1d8 fire damage (4d8 total) in a 25-foot radius and shatters all cover.

nodes.name: Thermite Core Bomb Resonance
nodes.description: Passive: Your class abilities deal +1d4 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource when below half health.

nodes.name: Unyielding Resolve
nodes.description: Passive: You gain +1 Damage Reduction against all attacks and advantage on saving throws against stun and fear.

nodes.name: Master of Cataclysm
nodes.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 2 AP: For 2 rounds, all your acid and explosive damage completely ignores enemy Armor and Damage Reduction, and 50% of single-target explosive damage splashes to all enemies within 15 feet.

nodes.name: Toxicologist Doctrine
nodes.description: Passive: All damage and healing dealt by your Toxicologist abilities is increased by +1 flat magnitude.

nodes.name: Chain Detonation
nodes.description: Passive: When an enemy dies from acid or explosive damage, they detonate for 2d8 acid damage to all adjacent enemies, shredding 2 Armor.

nodes.name: Impervious Hazmat Suit
nodes.description: Passive: You are immune to Acid and Fire damage, and you take zero friendly-fire or self-damage from your own explosives.

nodes.name: Transcendent Precision
nodes.description: Passive: All critical strikes deal +1d6 bonus damage and restore 1d4 Hit Points.
